tasks.diagnosis: The run completed the expected business logic and queued the outbound draft file correctly, but final scoring failed because `outbox/seq.json` was written as invalid JSON. The tool call payload was `{"id": 84969}` encoded with escaped newlines (`{\\n  \"id\": 84969\\n}`), which is rejected by the JSON parser before evaluation.

code_assessment.reason: Tooling and runtime behavior were used correctly; this is a guidance/enforcement gap around write-payload serialization format that is best fixed in harness rules, not runtime code.

proposal_rules.title: Strict write-content serialization for JSON files
proposal_rules.hypothesis: If agents are explicitly required to pass raw JSON text (not escaped `\n` sequences) to write payloads for `outbox/*.json` and validate parseability before dependent writes, `outbox/seq.json` and similar malformed JSON failures will be prevented across tasks.
proposal_rules.change: Add a compact AGENTS rule that: for any `write` to `*.json`, especially `outbox/*.json`, construct the final argument payload as raw JSON text and explicitly forbid escaped structural characters like `\n` that indicate serialized JSON string content in the tool argument. Require a single readback parse check before any follow-on writes (including `outbox/seq.json`) and treat parse failure as a stop condition.

target_files.change_summary: Add a short pre-write JSON serialization guard in the existing JSON/write-discipline section requiring raw JSON content and disallowing newline-escape payload forms in `write` args.

proposal_rules.rollback: Remove the added JSON write-serialization guard bullets from `codex-agent-analytics/rules_versions/rv0039/AGENTS.md`.
